text.tspan: WS1 - PART 1 - Shared 5-Hop Multi-Tenant Agent Platform Architecture
Google Cloud — Shared 80% 5-Hop Governance & Control Plane (< 42ms p95 Overhead)
Mints ECDSA P-256 STS JWT & 2LO/3LO CAB
Inline Model Armor & Cloud DLP screen (<8ms)
Blocks indirect RAG injection & PII/PHI egress
Hop 5 Memory Bank & Data (Pool / PSC / Silo)
Hop 5B (Silo): Dedicated GCP Project + HSM CMEK
AI Observability & Fail-Closed Circuit Breakers — HTTP 401 / 403 / 429 / 422
Zero-PII SHA-256 prompt hashing • BigQuery FinOps chargeback • <60s (41.2s) HSM CMEK kill-switch audit
WHO RUNS WHAT IN WS1 (5-HOP CONTROL PLANE)
Hops 1, 2 & 4 + Hop 3 rate cap + Hop 5 perimeters & audit
80% shared across all tiers: Edge PEP, STS DPoP broker, both Gateways, ARD PDP, Model Armor
Front end, Hop 3 ADK runtime (Cloud Run Gen2 gVisor) & 32k prefix
Runs identical core ADK Python code across every tier; pooled in Patterns A/C or dedicated
Hop 3 Valkey sessions + Hop 5 20% per-pattern tenant stores
Only the 20% Hop 5 perimeter changes by tier: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY pool (A), /28 PSC
Caller tiers (left) are not a plane. The 80% 5-Hop pipeline stays identical while Hop 5 routes each
turn to Pool, PSC Spoke, or Silo.
